name: visualize-mechanics-desktop
description: Desktop application for visualizing physics problems with 3D animations

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: cd frontend && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: cd frontend && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: cd frontend && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: cd frontend && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
